limits: Native wins use synthetic legal levels, party ownership, completed story gates, crafted +6 gear, full HP and no constellations. This does not measure acquiring that gear or those prerequisites.
Each fight begins fully healed. Healing time, restoration items, Mora earning, travel, and human/network variability are excluded.
No calendar time gate exists; weekly supply examples describe a commission schedule and do not prevent more farming in the same day.
The final requirement candidate 800/1600 is a model, not proof of the runtime cost or a complete character-training duration.
Adjacent stage comparisons are only Lv55 versus Lv60 at seed717 with this particular team/policy.
